1479-2841-7885-8103.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-7885-8103.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, Down in the Valley and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Down in the Valley trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

6798-7936--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist has a +1/+1 counter on it.
6798-7936--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. Choose to have it enter as a copy of the creature with persist with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from Dominion Saboteur as a state-based action.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2411-3259-4068.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
2411-3259-4068.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Lathril, triggering Breath of Fury and Lathril.
Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

206-3259-7795.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-3259-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

206-1409-3099-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7692-7736.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3995-6287-7704.notablePrerequisites:
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness and has power 6 or greater.
Horseshoe Crab and Doc Samson are exiled by Mimeoplasm.
3995-6287-7704.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Doc Samson.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least six {U}
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Horseshoe Crab.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1170-1636-7419.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1170-1636-7419.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast a copy of Ancestral Recall by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emeritus of Ideation. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
When Emeritus of Ideation enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Ancestral Recall, causing you to draw three cards.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7228.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two instant and/or sorcery cards in all graveyards.
2511-6972-7228.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Academy Elite.
When Academy Elite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

489-586-2292-5258-5618.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

147-2438-7281.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2438-7281.description:
Cast Leonardo's Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Leonardo's Technique.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Leonardo's Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Leonardo's Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2438-7281.notes: If desired, you can cast Leonardo's Technique for its sneak cost instead, reducing the mana cost by {2}.

2034-4871-5496-6201-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sunscape Familiar.
Repeat.

5702-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1350-2793-2829-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Kefka, Court Mage // Kefka, Ruler of Ruin

1786-6574.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1786-6574.description:
Draw a card.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Kefka triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-4616-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2292-4616-6249--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

997-1339-5572.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
997-1339-5572.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

75-301-4050.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
75-301-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {B/G}.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Quillspike by paying {B/G} and removing the -1/-1 counter from Putrid Goblin, giving Quillspike +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2034-3008-3048-3197.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2034-3008-3048-3197.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Roalesk.
Put the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The creature triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers twice, creating two 4/4 Beast creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

710-3055-5256.notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Danitha.
710-3055-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Danitha's power.
Repeat.

719-3670-4508.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
719-3670-4508.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ingenious Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Ingenious Artillerist is a Pirate due to Xenograft, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Ingenious Artillerist triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Ingenious Artillerist trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

479-1267-1561-3365.notablePrerequisites:
Medomai does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
You have at least 26 cards in library.
You have at least 2 life.
479-1267-1561-3365.description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss, drawing at least twelve cards and losing half your life total.
Move to combat.
Attack with Medomai, dealing combat damage and gaining an extra turn.
Activate Aeromeba by discarding a card to switch Aeromeba's power and toughness until end of turn.
Repeat step 4 until you have exactly thirteen cards in your hand.
Pass to the extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Triskaidekaphile triggers, winning the game.
